name: Fledermaus
kurzbeschreibung:
**Bat in Seefeld in Tirol** – Discover the enchanting world of bats in the heart of the Alps!

Experience a unique evening event where you’ll learn fascinating facts about these nocturnal creatures. Guided by experts, you’ll explore the secrets of bats in their natural habitat near **Seefeld in Tirol**, surrounded by breathtaking mountain scenery.

A perfect blend of adventure and education for nature lovers and families alike!
